WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) AS metric_time__month
    , CASE WHEN case when is_paid_eligible then member_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , case when is_paid_eligible then valid_order_count else 0 end AS __monthly_paid_order_count
    , case when is_paid_eligible then net_sales_cents else 0 end AS __monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , CASE WHEN case when is_paid_eligible and valid_order_count >= 2 then member_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."monthly_paid_member_summary" monthly_paid_member_summary_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_10.metric_time__month, subq_16.metric_time__month) AS metric_time__month
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(CAST(subq_16.monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_16.monthly_paid_buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
  , MAX(CAST(subq_16.monthly_paid_sales_cents AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_16.monthly_paid_order_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_10
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_16
ON
  subq_10.metric_time__month = subq_16.metric_time__month
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_10.metric_time__month, subq_16.metric_time__month)

统计范围为2026年7月1日至8月31日（两个完整自然月），在当前客户青禾的数据范围内按自然月分组，未做跨月合计，也未额外按门店或渠道拆分；统计对象为各月最后一日符合付费会员资格（悦享年卡或家庭季卡同日有效，任一卡满足且不按卡重复）的账户，其当月全渠道、全门店有效订单。人数按CRM会员账户计数，不等同于跨系统自然人已去重。净销售额为有效订单实付减退款。

| 自然月 | 月末付费会员购买人数 | 月末付费会员有效订单数 | 月末付费会员净销售额 | 月末付费会员复购人数 | 月末付费会员复购率 | 月末付费会员订单均额 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2026年7月 | 6 | 6 | 155.00元（15,500分） | 0 | 0.00% | 25.83元/单 |
| 2026年8月 | 6 | 10 | 475.50元（47,550分） | 4 | 66.67% | 47.55元/单 |

复购率=复购人数/购买人数；订单均额=净销售额/有效订单数。两个月购买人数均非0，因此复购率和订单均额均有定义；7月复购人数为0，复购率为0.00%，不是未定义。
question: 请按自然月分别列出2026年7月和8月青禾优选的月末付费会员购买人数、月末付费会员有效订单数、月末付费会员净销售额（单位分）、月末付费会员复购人数、月末付费会员复购率和月末付费会员订单均额；保留各月，不给跨月合计。
